quarter.zh: 2027 财年第一季（9 月季度）

en: Revenue of $2.37B grew 50% (56% pro forma) and beat the ~$2.31B estimate, led by Datacenter & Communications at $1.95B (+79%), while Industrial fell 15% to $419M. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.09 beat ~$1.98 and gross margin rose to 40.6%. The Q2 guide of $2.55–2.75B and EPS of $2.28–2.48 sits about 4% and 8% above consensus. Management expects FY27 growth above 60% and a $3B quarter by June 2027, and the CFO lifted the long-term margin goal above 45%. Capex of $776M left free cash flow near −$868M.

Shares rose about 5% after hours to near $205, then reversed and fell 13.0% on Nov 5 to $169.76, after trading as low as $160. The beat was swamped by a broad AI-hardware selloff that coverage tied to Democrats' midterm gains and worries about AI funding, hitting peers such as Ciena and Credo too. Investors also focused on cash burn: operating cash flow was −$93M and inventory rose to $3.3B. Stifel still raised its target to $450.
zh: 营收 23.7 亿美元，同比增长 50%（备考口径 56%），高于约 23.1 亿美元的预期；数据中心与通信业务 19.5 亿美元（+79%）领先，工业业务下降 15% 至 4.19 亿美元。非 GAAP 每股收益 2.09 美元，高于约 1.98 美元的预期，毛利率升至 40.6%。第二季指引营收 25.5–27.5 亿美元、每股收益 2.28–2.48 美元，分别比市场预期高约 4% 和 8%。管理层预计 FY27 增长超过 60%，2027 年 6 月前单季营收达 30 亿美元；CFO 将长期毛利率目标上调至 45% 以上。资本开支 7.76 亿美元，自由现金流约 −8.68 亿美元。

股价盘后上涨约 5% 至 205 美元附近，但 11 月 5 日反转收跌 13.0% 至 169.76 美元，盘中一度低至 160 美元。业绩超预期被 AI 硬件板块全面抛售所淹没，媒体将其归因于民主党在中期选举中的收获及对 AI 融资的担忧，Ciena、Credo 等同行也受波及。投资者还关注现金消耗：经营现金流为 −9300 万美元，存货升至 33 亿美元。Stifel 仍将目标价上调至 450 美元。

bio.en: CEO since June 2024 after six years as CEO of Lattice Semiconductor, where margins and the stock rose sharply. Earlier ran AMD's computing and graphics business and held roles at Intel and Broadcom. Is refocusing Coherent on AI data-center optics and paying down debt.
bio.zh: 2024 年 6 月出任 CEO，此前任莱迪思半导体 CEO 六年，期间利润率与股价大幅提升。更早曾执掌 AMD 计算与图形业务，并在英特尔和博通任职。正将 Coherent 重心转向 AI 数据中心光器件并削减债务。

bio.en: Rejoined Coherent as CFO in 2024 from Lattice Semiconductor, where she had been CFO since 2019 alongside Anderson. Before that she spent 16 years at Coherent Inc., including as corporate VP of finance.
bio.zh: 2024 年从莱迪思半导体重返 Coherent 任 CFO，她自 2019 年起在莱迪思担任 CFO，与安德森共事。此前在 Coherent Inc. 工作 16 年，曾任财务副总裁。

sources.t: Why the stock fell on Nov 5 (TIKR)
